question: For veg whsle data, can you analyze our financial performance over the years 2020 to 2023? I need insights into the average wholesale price, maximum wholesale price, minimum wholesale price, wholesale price difference, total wholesale price, total selling price, average loss rate, total loss, and profit for each category within each year. Round all calculated values to two decimal places.
sql:
WITH wholesale_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(whsle_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
        item_code,
        AVG("whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS avg_whsle_px,
        MAX("whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS max_whsle_px,
        MIN("whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS min_whsle_px,
        SUM("whsle_px_rmb-kg") AS total_whsle_px
    FROM veg_whsle_df
    WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(whsle_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
    GROUP BY CAST(SUBSTR(whsle_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER), item_code
),
transactions_agg AS (
    SELECT 
        CAST(SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) AS year,
        item_code,
        SUM("qty_sold(kg)" * "unit_selling_px_rmb/kg") AS total_selling_px
    FROM veg_txn_df
    WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) BETWEEN 2020 AND 2023
      AND "sale/return" = 'sale'
    GROUP BY CAST(SUBSTR(txn_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER), item_code
),
loss_rates AS (
    SELECT item_code, "loss_rate_%" FROM veg_loss_rate_df
),
categories AS (
    SELECT item_code, category_name FROM veg_cat
),
combined AS (
    SELECT 
        c.category_name,
        wa.year,
        wa.avg_whsle_px,
        wa.max_whsle_px,
        wa.min_whsle_px,
        wa.total_whsle_px,
        COALESCE(tr.total_selling_px, 0) AS total_selling_px,
        lr."loss_rate_%" AS loss_rate
    FROM wholesale_agg wa
    JOIN categories c ON wa.item_code = c.item_code
    LEFT JOIN transactions_agg tr ON wa.item_code = tr.item_code AND wa.year = tr.year
    LEFT JOIN loss_rates lr ON wa.item_code = lr.item_code
)
SELECT 
    category_name,
    year,
    ROUND(AVG(avg_whsle_px), 2) AS avg_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(MAX(max_whsle_px), 2) AS max_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(MIN(min_whsle_px), 2) AS min_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(MAX(max_whsle_px) - MIN(min_whsle_px), 2) AS wholesale_price_difference,
    ROUND(SUM(total_whsle_px), 2) AS total_wholesale_price,
    ROUND(SUM(total_selling_px), 2) AS total_selling_price,
    ROUND(AVG(loss_rate), 2) AS avg_loss_rate,
    ROUND(SUM(total_whsle_px) * AVG(loss_rate) / 100, 2) AS total_loss,
    ROUND(SUM(total_selling_px) - SUM(total_whsle_px), 2) AS profit
FROM combined
GROUP BY category_name, year
ORDER BY category_name, year
